audioSourceNote: audio1-3 + audio5-9 in order; audio4 (earlier take of the audio5 line) unused. Only edge silence trimmed; 0.45 s gap before the verdict, 1.0 s save-frame hold after the checklist, 0.25 s elsewhere, 2.0 s end-card tail. No words cut or reordered. Voiceover text is the recorded wording from draft ASR: check by ear before captions.

colorMeanings.red: fake / trap / stolen (stamp, crosses, flags, thief)
colorMeanings.green: real and official (platform checks); the gate opening is shown green only as access granted
colorMeanings.yellow: the cookie ticket and highlight stickers
colorMeanings.dark canvas: inside the malware (what you cannot see)

scenes.voiceover: صاحبك بعثلك lien فيه: حمّل GTA 6 للـPC مجانا. زعما صح ولا كذب؟

events.what: phone already rising, chat bubble sliding in, phone buzz (motion on frame 0)
link card unfolds: neon-city thumbnail, 'GTA 6 PC · FREE · 2.1 GB'
green DOWNLOAD chip pulses; cursor glides toward it
sticker 'مجانا' slaps on the card (yellow)
two buttons pop under the card: صح (green) / كذب (red), cursor hovers between them
hold 0.45 s: cursor freezes, buttons wobble (open loop)

scenes.voiceover: ماكاش منها. GTA 6 خرجت غير على PS5 و Xbox

events.what: red Stamp 'كذب' slams on the link card (hit)
card slides up and shrinks; platform row builds below
console box 'PS5' + green check
console box 'XBOX SERIES' + green check

scenes.voiceover: ما كاين حتى نسخة PC، وما كاين حتى نسخة Android

events.what: PC monitor slides in, XStamp (hit)
phone slides in, XStamp 'ANDROID' (hit)

scenes.voiceover: إذن أي fichier مكتوب عليه GTA 6 PC ولا GTA 6 APK... ماهيش اللعبة الأصلية. بصح السؤال

events.what: BrowserCard 'gta6-free-pc.download' drops in: 3 flashing DOWNLOAD buttons, countdown 00:09
file chip 'GTA6_Setup.exe' falls out
file chip 'GTA6.apk' falls out
sticker 'ماشي اللعبة' (red) over both files
camera pushes into GTA6_Setup.exe; LockedChip 'INSIDE · ?' shakes
icon wobbles, '?' pulses

scenes.voiceover: في بزاف الحالات، كاين برنامج اسمو infostealer، يعني سارق. كي تفتحو، يقرا الـpasswords المسجلين في الـbrowser

events.what: chip unlocks; dark blueprint; thief glyph (hooked hand) crawls out
TermLabel 'INFOSTEALER' pops
gloss 'سارق' snaps under it
BrowserCard 'SAVED PASSWORDS' opens: 3 rows ●●●●●●
rows pulled one by one along DrawPath into bag 'SERVER' (scan + tick)
TicketChip cookie (yellow, from the cookies video) pulled out after the passwords
green pill 'CONNECTÉ' on the ticket as it flies into the bag

scenes.voiceover: وبالـcookie هادي، ما يحتاجش حتى الـpassword. يدخل للـFacebook ولا Instagram نتاعك كأنو نتا

events.what: thief holds the yellow ticket in front of a login gate (NodeBox 'ACCOUNT')
password field ●●●● gets struck through (small XStamp)
ticket slides in, gate turns green 'WELCOME BACK' (unlock)
generic ProfileCard (invented name, no platform logo)
card flips: same avatar, thief glyph behind it (morph); footnote '* ماشي ديما'

scenes.voiceover: ويبعث نفس الـlien لصحابك. وهكا وصلك من عند صاحبك

events.what: link bubble from scene 1 clones out to 5 friend chats along DrawPaths
camera zooms into the last chat
it is exactly the frame-1 chat: 'صاحبي' + same link card (loop closed, hit)

scenes.voiceover: وكاين نوع آخر: يخلي الـPC نتاعك يخدم للـcrypto في الخفية. يسخن، يبطا، والـventilateur ما يحبسش

events.what: PC tower on blueprint, fan idle
SpeedDial 'CPU' sweeps to 100%
small coins float out the back toward a far NodeBox 'NOT YOU'
Thermometer rises to red ('يسخن')
SpeedBar drops red ('يبطا')
fan spins faster and faster, hum rises; sticker 'PC يخدم لغيرك'

scenes.voiceover: إذن كيفاش تعرف الـarnaque؟ واحد: اللعبة ماهيش في الـstore الرسمي؟ ماشي هي. جوج: يقولك طفّي الـantivirus ولا سمّح بـunknown apps؟ هرب. ثلاثة: يطلب رقمك ولا دراهم باش يفتحلك التحميل؟ arnaque.

events.what: MiniUI card title '3 علامات الـarnaque' + counter 0/3
row 1: store icon + cross 'ماشي في الـstore الرسمي'
red flag on row 1 ('ماشي هي')
row 2: shield switching off 'طفّي الـantivirus / unknown apps'
red flag + mini stamp 'هرب' on row 2
row 3: number field + coin 'رقمك ولا دراهم'
red flag row 3; stamp 'ARNAQUE' on the card
full card held 1.0 s, all rows at full opacity, pin chip 'سيفيها' (silent save cue)

scenes.voiceover: GTA 6 PC؟ ماكاش منها. الـcrack هذا ما يسرقش اللعبة... يسرقك نتا

events.what: frame-1 link card returns with red 'كذب' stamp
headline types 'ما يسرقش اللعبة'
'اللعبة' struck through, replaced by 'يسرقك نتا' in red (hit)

scenes.voiceover: ابعث الفيديو لصاحبك اللي راهو يستنى فيه.

events.what: send arrow flies the link card into a chat labelled 'صاحبك' (share cue)
end card: Runtime.tech wordmark + ScanLine, series pill 'صح ولا كذب؟ · 01', teaser chip 'الجاي: كيفاش ترجع الـaccount', FOLLOW button
chat bubble pops in at the same spot as frame 1 (loop)
